// Fixture — should NOT be flagged.
//
// An unexported *Service method is out of scope. The rule only
// flags exported methods because only they form the wails-bypass
// surface (CLI / MCP / plugin-gateway dispatch can only invoke
// exported methods).

package fixture

type Service struct{}

func PathJoin(parts ...string) string {
	out := ""
	for _, p := range parts {
		out += p + "/"
	}
	return out
}

// resolvePath is unexported — even though it reaches PathJoin
// from an id without IsValidID, it cannot be reached directly
// from outside the package via reflection-based dispatch.
func (s *Service) resolvePath(id string) string {
	return PathJoin("/data", id)
}
